takeaways: Every-game spread picks went 9-5-1. Most are tiny gaps, so about half is expected.
Best prop type this season: Rushing yards, Under (104-72, +20.40 units).
Weakest: Rushing yards, Over (92-119, -36.66 units). Worth avoiding until it turns.
Closing lines: 5 picks beat the close, 5 were worse, 5 didn't move.
Rushing yards: overs hit only 42.8% at the model's fair line (425 graded). The model runs high here, so unders have an edge.
